title: agropyron repens subsp. virescens
intro: Agropyron repens subsp. virescens, commonly known as couch grass, is a type of plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and aiding in the treatment of respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of couch grass include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which make it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of couch grass include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
